title: Ilvizora no Touhikou
titleNative: イルビゾーラの逃避行
synopsis: The sixth Demon King, Ilvizora, flees before his final battle with the hero. Having abandoned the fight and run away, Ilvizora encounters Enea, a human girl who has never known freedom. As a slave, she believes that humans are more terrifying than demons. Ilvizora ends up helping Enea, and they begin traveling together... The story depicts the escape of a Demon King who wants to live peacefully after abandoning everything, and a former slave girl. (Source: Natalie, translated)

synopsis: Youki died in a traffic accident and was reborn in a fantasy world! However, instead of being the hero of legends, he ended up reincarnating into an overpowered demon. Having no desire to become the Demon Lord, he sits around in the Demon Lord's castle as a random low rank guardian. One day, the Hero's party comes to attack and on a whim he knocks out the entire hero party. Healing up the Hero party and then preparing to send them back to town, he notices the female priest and falls in love at first sight! (Source: Manga Mirai)

title: Smile!
synopsis: A journalist risks everything to uncover the truth behind a sinister cult... Yuushi Kamome is a freelance journalist who lost his beloved daughter in an unforeseen accident. His descent into despair following her death drove his wife to leave him, and he lives each day a shell of the man he once was. But his fate changes one day when members from a religious organization he had never heard of, the Smiling Hearts Society, knock on his door and hand him a flyer. He’s ready to dismiss them until he notices the face of his estranged wife on the flyer, smiling ever so softly. And so begins a tale of religion and insanity. What kind of sinister darkness lurks behind this religion and its strange smiles? (Source: Kodama)

title: Youheidan no Ryouriban
synopsis: The story begins when Azuma Akari, a young man with an ambition to be a chef, trips into another world. Akari is picked up by Gangreve, the leader of a mercenary group. Akari joins the group as an odd job and gradually increases hia own value by demonstrating hia cooking skills. Each leader of the mercenary group is a quirky character, but Akari connects with them through his cooking. By improving the mercenary group's food situation and occasionally helping with inventions, Akari is gradually recognized by his fellow members of the mercenary group. However, Akari does not yet know that he himself will become a hero.

synopsis: I've known Ta-kun ever since we were 10 years old. Even though we are now in high school, we still spend our days in his room, talking about nothing in particular. We are close, but our relationship is not quite as sweet as lovers… Why won't you notice me? I'm trying so hard to get closer to you! I am Hikari Shirasaka, 16 years old… It might be a little late for me to tell you this, but I think I've fallen in love with you, my childhood friend. (Source: ComicWalker, translated) Note: Originally self-published, it was picked up for commercial serialization starting 2025-02-17.
